prompt:
Create one realistic continuous TEN-SECOND vertical 9:16 image-to-video shot, 720x1280. Reference 1 is the exact opening frame for composition, person and setting. Reference 2 is the original product crop: lock product design to it throughout, do not cut to or display this reference separately.
ONE compact pastel lavender power bank from the reference crop. Rounded rectangular thick smooth shell, broad glossy black rounded-rectangle battery-level window inset near one end of its broad front face, original small white level markings inside that window, lavender edge seam, matching flexible loop strap attached at that end, small side openings only where visible in the original. Preserve exact body proportions, the black window shape/location, original markings, lavender finish and loop strap. This is a portable power bank, NOT a phone, speaker, cosmetic case or purse. No added logo or brand, no invented port layout, connector, integrated charging cable, wireless charging coil or accessory. The loop is a STRAP, not a proven charging cable. Reference image does not establish actual capacity, charge rate, charging protocol or runtime. Keep the original product's visible front three-quarter orientation; do not show an invented rear view.
Keep the SAME fictional adult and clothes, scene and lighting as reference 1. The power bank is one RIGID physical prop: never change its shell, black window, original markings, color or strap. Keep its front in the SAME three-quarter orientation as the opening photograph, no product spin, turn, flip, tilt or showing the back. Keep its full body and loop strap within the central 75% of every frame. No giant foreground push-in, no product crossing frame edges.
Natural purposeful motion starts immediately, no long still hold, no slow motion and no slideshow. Use the specified hand/camera action, not an orbit. Relaxed closed mouth, no lip-sync. No connecting or disconnecting cables, no simulated charging speed, no animated display or percentage jumps. Keep original display markings unchanged. No extra devices or accessories except those explicitly already visible in the opening.

ACTION: From frame zero camera slides sideways 10 cm at a fixed distance, retaining the original product angle. Supporting palm stays still; the free index finger briefly indicates the outer rounded edge from BESIDE it, then opens to a small presentation. Do not touch the display, lift the loop or change grip.
No added graphics, captions, narration, music or sound effects.
